messages:
zoe: quick flag — ran through the hello-starterkit quickstart and hit two UX friction points: the README suggests setting REDWOOD_SECRET_KEY but the starter reads CLIENT_KEY. also the Deploy -> checklist link 404s. opening a tiny PR to standardize env names, add a short troubleshooting FAQ, and patch the dead link. cc @ben @rachel :wave:

ben: thanks! can you paste the exact mismatch so i can update the node and python snippets in the examples?

zoe: sure — current confusing snippet in the doc:

```bash
# README (old)
export REDWOOD_SECRET_KEY=sk-...
npm run start
```
\nchanged in branch to the canonical env name REDWOOD_API_KEY and a one-liner compatibility shim in the starter app. new doc snippet:

```bash
# canonical
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
# for docker add to .env: REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
npm run start
```
\nrachel: nice. i like the shim idea for a short migration window. what shim did you add in the starter?

zoe: added this in both node and python starters:

```js
// node starter
const apiKey = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.CLIENT_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_SECRET_KEY;
```
```py
# python starter
api_key = os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY') or os.getenv('CLIENT_KEY') or os.getenv('REDWOOD_SECRET_KEY')
```
\nben: can we also show a tiny curl example next to the SDK snippet so newcomers understand header -> SDK mapping? e.g. curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` and node: `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`. keeps cognitive load low.

zoe: added side-by-side curl + node + python minimal examples and a 1-line note about token rotation linking to secrets docs. i also fixed the broken deploy checklist link (old: /docs/deploy-old/checklist -> new: /docs/deploy/checklist) and filed a redirect with infra. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523 — includes compose smoke test and linkcheck.

docs-bot: PR #523 opened by zoe: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523 — checks: smoke-compose, linkcheck, spellcheck. status: running.

ben: small UX ask: move the env-var troubleshooting callout above the first "Start the app" step so people see it before running commands. also change the banner to a short :warning: tip: "Use REDWOOD_API_KEY — starter accepts CLIENT_KEY/REDWOOD_SECRET_KEY for a short transition period."

zoe: moved the callout and added that exact banner. kept the banner one line and added an inline link to the SDK migration guide for teams on older clients.

infra-bot: Redirect ticket created: #infra-redirects-77 for /docs/deploy-old/checklist -> /docs/deploy/checklist.

rachel: once CI goes green, please merge and update the repo README so GitHub shows the corrected env name in the preview. i'll run a quick canary on the onboarding pipeline after merge.

zoe: will merge on green. i'll also drop a short note in #support after merge so we can monitor if env-related tickets drop. thanks all :tada:
